title: Red Dead Redemption 2
provenance: tested locally on Apple Silicon (M1 Pro), macOS 26.6.2, engine x64-crossover26.3-r5, 2026-09-10: loads to 98 per cent and never renders. Status stays community because there is no verdict for a title we tested and could not run.
notes: Loads but never renders on this Mac as of 2026-09-10. Tested on an M1 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, engine x64-crossover26.3-r5. What works: the Rockstar Games Launcher renders and signs in on its own, RDR2 starts, opens a window that composites at 1280x720, and loads for about six minutes to 98 per cent. Then it exits cleanly without presenting a frame. The game always uses its own Vulkan renderer, so Highball's graphics mode applies to the launcher only. MoltenVK 1.4.1 then refuses the images it asks for, and the last three refusals come immediately before the exit: 'vkCreateImage(): If tiling is VK_IMAGE_TILING_LINEAR, mipLevels must be 1' (3) and the same for 'imageType must be VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D' (16). Earlier in the run MoltenVK's shader translator also emits Metal that will not compile, writing gl_CullDistance into a vertex output struct that does not declare it, which kills one pipeline, and Apple's driver logs about 10900 'AGX: Texture read/write assertion failed: bytes_per_row >= used_bytes_per_row' assertions. The failure is byte-identical across runs (16/5/3/1/1/1). Six ways of moving it to DirectX 12 were tried and none works: -dx12 in commandline.txt in the game folder is ignored, so is the same file in Documents/Rockstar Games/Red Dead Redemption 2/Settings; the game never writes a system.xml because it never finishes a run, so its own settings cannot be edited; setting the graphics mode to D3DMetal makes the Rockstar launcher stop opening a window at all, because the launcher needs a Direct3D 10.1 device that D3DMetal does not provide; putting D3DMetal's d3d12.dll and dxgi.dll in the game's own folder with a per-application native override for RDR2.exe leaves the game on Vulkan regardless; and Vulkan cannot be taken away to force the issue because RDR2.exe hard-imports ffx_fsr2_api_vk_x64.dll, which hard-imports vulkan-1.dll, so the process fails to load at all (status c0000135). The fix belongs in MoltenVK.

knownIssues.symptom: Loads to about 98 per cent, opens a window, then exits without showing a frame.
knownIssues.cause: the game's own Vulkan renderer asks MoltenVK for linear-tiled images with more than one mip level, which MoltenVK 1.4.1 refuses.
knownIssues.fix: none today. The graphics mode cannot help: this is the game's own Vulkan, not a Direct3D translation layer, and DirectX 12 cannot be selected because the game ignores -dx12 and never writes a settings file.
